title: SDCC – Small Device C Compiler
summary: SDCC (Small Device C Compiler) is a free, open-source optimizing C compiler specifically designed for embedded systems and microcontrollers, supporting multiple processor architectures including Intel 8051, Zilog Z80, Microchip PIC, and others.
problem_solved: Provides free compilation tools for resource-constrained microcontrollers and embedded devices where expensive commercial compilers would otherwise be required.
why_valuable: Enables hobbyists, students, and developers to program embedded systems with C language without licensing costs, democratizing embedded development.
